sonnet.problem: This statement reuses the wrong answer from card 8 ('Lets him go back to Jerusalem'), turned into 'Jehoahaz makes it back from Egypt and reigns in Jerusalem again.' It also re-asks the fact card 8 just settled, that Neco carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt. And it bundles two claims, that he makes it back and that he reigns again.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. / A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The question gives the line 'according to the word the LORD had spoken through His servants the ___' and asks the baker to complete its final word. No earlier card showed this wording or says the LORD had spoken beforehand, so the baker can only recall the phrase or guess it.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
